What should I do if the tracking never updates?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
If your tracking number isn’t updating or shows no movement, it usually means the carrier hasn’t scanned the package yet. This can happen when the label is created but the carrier hasn’t picked it up or processed it.
Here are a few things you can do:
Check your email (including spam/junk) for the tracking message and any carrier notifications.
Log into your Living Spaces account and review the order details to find the tracking number.
Use the carrier’s tracking page (for example, UPS tracking) to see the latest updates.
Refresh the tracking page later, as updates can appear after the carrier scans the shipment.
Sometimes tracking simply lags behind the actual shipment, so it may update once the carrier processes the package.
